verdict.rationale: MX's Instant Account Verification product retrieves account and routing numbers for an end user's demand deposit accounts from a linked institution, and supports Tokenized Account Numbers (TANs) for secure ACH money movement. Microdeposits are documented as a separate, alternate verification method, so instant retrieval avoids micro-deposits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the verification response and the API flow for TANs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can obtain verified account and routing numbers (or tokenized equivalents) from a linked account to fund ACH or bank-debit payments without micro-deposits

citations.quote: With Instant Account Verification, you can connect to an end user's financial institution and retrieve account and routing numbers for their demand deposit accounts.
Tokenized Account Numbers (TANs) are substitute account numbers used for secure ACH money movement.
Microdeposits is different—it provides an alternate method for verifying account ownership by making small test deposits to an account.
